title: Make the importer resumable
prompt: Add a durable checkpoint to the importer so an interrupted run resumes from the last committed batch instead of restarting from zero.
objective: An interrupted import resumes without duplicating or skipping rows.
context: The importer currently restarts from zero after any interruption.
The checkpoint belongs in the existing SQLite database, per the user's answer.
requirements: Persist a checkpoint after each committed batch, in the same transaction as the batch.
Resume from the stored checkpoint on startup.
constraints: No schema change to the public tables.
acceptance_criteria: Killing the importer mid-run and restarting it imports every row exactly once.
A run with no stored checkpoint behaves exactly as today.
